study: optional bounded two-owner stateless native batching
status: prospective; no new native inference or timing has run
scope: Implementation equivalence and performance pilot; not a quality corpus or amendment to the frozen eight-arm study.

reference.source_binding: Record the exact producing commit, binary hashes, lockfiles, native/model identities and full material bundle before accepting new results.

resources.measurement: Fresh cgroup per arm and repetition; all compared processes, helpers, and the Tika/gateway/bridge path when present share the total cap.
resources.model_cache: Immutable model files verified before timing and filesystem page cache warmed; this is not cold-storage startup and memory.peak can exclude file pages charged to a prior cgroup.
resources.rejection: Reject missing or incompatible CPU/affinity/ancestor quota, wrong immutable identity, OOM, unexpected signal, unowned process, incomplete result set or incomplete cleanup; retain all failed evidence.

native_gates.actual_shared_call: At least one returned Session::run per stage has positive row counts from each distinct admitted owner, with different pixel rows.
native_gates.canonical_fixture: Distinct two-page TIFF frames; diagnostic box covers the full first frame and the left 90% of the second frame before the ordinary source-faithful crop expansion.
native_gates.input: Valid normalized input f32 bits exactly equal; all added padding is zero and excluded from valid-region comparison.
native_gates.discrete: Exact valid CTC lengths, token IDs, decoded token counts, script threshold decisions and final UTF-8 owner text.
native_gates.padding: Require the shared batch to change at least one row's padded width; align by identity rather than raw flattened tensor length.
native_gates.refill: Three distinct admissions, at most two active owners; a third request enters a completed slot while its peer remains live; every admission completes once with its own text and TIFF frame order.
native_gates.cancellation: Canceled or invalid owner clears only its response; the live peer must finish. Never release either reservation while their native call is in flight.
native_gates.lifecycle: Both drain command and SIGTERM after two uploads are admitted but before either body completes; readyz becomes503 while active remains2; both bodies finish, exact responses arrive, real shared script/CTC events occur, and child exits0.
native_gates.default_regression: Rerun the existing native unit/TIFF/math gates and frozen14-case source-reference comparison using the newly linked default engine.

control_cost.included: Both arms construct and sort each owner's indices from identical unsorted widths, then select every row.
control_cost.standalone_allocation_gate: System allocator, prepared selection only, 600 paired-page sweeps; exact zero allocations/reallocations/deallocations/bytes_allocated/bytes_deallocated/bytes_reallocated. Excludes native code and page/session setup.

paired_measurement.status: controller and native execution still required; do not infer outcomes from control-cost tests
layers: gateway plus Tika plus bridge plus native service
paired_measurement.arm_order: Even repetition ordinary then experimental; odd repetition experimental then ordinary. Record every started repetition and preserve failures.
paired_measurement.warmup: Warm all enabled sessions and execute each selected fixture once before timing; expected text is checked against the same configuration's unmeasured ordinary reference pass.
paired_measurement.sample_units: Request latencies are nested in repetition/cgroup and fixture; aggregate at paired repetition, not as independent pages.
paired_measurement.latency: Successful complete-body latency, nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 with numerator and failure denominator; include upload, queue and response lifetime for end-to-end layer.
paired_measurement.interpretation: Report paired raw differences and descriptive distributions. Twelve requests per repetition cannot resolve a stable p99. These synthetic implementation inputs do not establish representative multilingual production performance.
paired_measurement.decision: Engineering screen, not a significance claim: zero added errors; all ownership/numerical/lifecycle gates pass; at both CPU profiles median paired throughput ratio is at least1.05 for concurrency2 and3; median paired p95 ratio is at most1.05 at every concurrency; median paired CPU-use-per-success ratio is at most1.05; peak memory is within3GiB and at most1.25 times the paired ordinary arm. Report every ratio and failure. Even a pass keeps this synthetic-only pilot opt-in until a representative mixed-document deployment study; no universal optimum claim.

fixtures.scope: Existing heterogeneous-layout synthetic fixture processed with math=false for this stateless experiment; it is not math-quality evidence.

math_compaction.status: separate implementation and native experiment pending
math_compaction.allowed: Gather completed rows out of a same-age cohort while preserving the scalar step, cross caches, masks, self caches, tokens and original owner/line mapping.
math_compaction.not_equivalent: Insert an arbitrary-age BOS row into the current scalar-position/self-cache history or assume zero-filled history is an empty cache.
math_compaction.required: Compare original live-row cache values/logits/token/EOS/decoded output with explicit finite tolerance, record actual decoder row-steps and every gathered byte, then paired1/2CPU latency and memory including copy costs.
